notes.title: Announcement of SHOOTING STAR VR Release Date!
notes.notes:
🏹 Hello, warrior! 🏹

Following Archery Land, Looksten is releasing a sequel!

SHOOTING STAR VR is a story where you become a hero and wield a magic bow to rescue the goddess of Archery Land, who has been kidnapped!
It will be released on April 20th!

👇Please click "Add to Wishlist" below!👇

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2350290/SHOOTING_STAR_VR/

🎯We ask for your continued interest in SHOOTING STAR VR!🎯

notes.title: [Archery Land] Patch Note (Ver 0.8)
notes.notes:
Happy New Year, Warriors!
Archery Land Team is here! 

Below is the Ver 0.8 update patch for January 9, 2023.

[h1]** Ver 0.8 update highlights    ** [/h1]

[h3][b]1. Changed the size of the character's head.    [/b][/h3]
[list]
* Quadrupled!
[/list]
[h3][b]2. Changed the ‘language’ select button to 2D UI  [/b][/h3]


[h3] [b]3. Changed the list of tutorial guide   [/b][/h3]
[list]
* Each of ‘how-to’ guide for the Bow and Arrow will be shown one by one (not shown at the same time)   
* 3 practice targets (not 1) 
[/list]
[h3] [b]4. Changed the main UI   [/b][/h3]
[list]
* Enjoy 3 different modes!      
* Enjoy 6 different rank games! 
* Enjoy trying to challenge the Boss stage anytime! 
[/list]
[h3] [b]5. Changed Rank game UI      [/b][/h3]
[list]
* the ranking and score will be shown      
[/list]
[h3] [b]6. Changed Multi-game backgrounds   [/b][/h3]


[h3] [b]7. Changed Multi-game interaction way      [/b][/h3]
[list]
* Hold the bow to start the game      
* Select the target button, not the coin 
[/list]
[i]We updated with your feedbacks of value.[/i]
[i]Thank you for enjoying Archery Land[/i]

[b]
Good Luck,
Archery Land, Warriors! 
[/b]

Thank you
Looksten

notes.title: [Archery Land] Patch Note (Ver 0.7)
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone.
This is the Archery Land Team.

Please check out updates for Ver 0.7 on Friday, 14 October 2022.

[h1]Important features[/h1]
[h3][b]1. Some changes for the beginning scene.[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a new opening level.
[*] Added a new tutorial level.
[/list]

[h3][b]2. Some changes for the main UI.[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Changed ‘play-console’ to 2D UI.
[*] Updated for Ray-cast & Selection method.
[/list]

[h3] [b]3. Updates for the avatar hand.[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Updated for the avatar hand modelling and the avatar gloves modelling.
[/list]

[h3] [b]4. Updates for the avatar bow & arrow.[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Updated for the bow & arrow modelling and the hitting effect.
[/list]

[h3] [b]5. Updates for the target.[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Updated for the target modelling and the hitting effect.
[/list]


[i]We have updated Ver 0.7 with your valuable feedback.
On be half of the development team,  we would like to express our sincere thanks to everyone who loved our game![/i]

[b]
Good Luck,
Archery Land, Archers! 
[/b]
Thank you
Looksten

notes.title: [Archery Land] Patch Note (Ver 0.51)
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone. 
This is Archery Land.

Introduction to the application on 8 September 2022 (Thursday) new content for Ver 0.51.

[b]Important features[/b]
    1. Single game balance has been fixed.
          -  Single-player games tier scores has been lowered. (Except Boss)
          -  'Trap' and 'Flight' have been corrected.
                          ㆍ  Changed the appearance method of 'Timer Target'
[b]Visual[/b]
    1. The design & interaction of the language selection button has been changed.

We hope you enjoy 'Archery Land' while shooting a bow!

thank you
Looksten
